dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity consistent across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of dark-pixel clusters and elongated streaks primarily located across the central and posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the light-grey baseline canvas and localized darker pigmented streaks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark-pigmented linear marks, including a prominent longitudinal mark on the central posterior axis and several shorter diagonal streaks across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear markings across the dorsal surface consistent with superficial physical trauma or rake marks.
